title: Add grouping selectors to operational task commands
description: Add one shared six-field grouping-selector parser to task list, task ready, task next, graph, and legacy list/next paths. Support issueId, project, milestone, version, featureId, and feature; reject duplicate or empty selectors, pass identical filters to preview and claim, and keep graph limited to matching tasks and internal edges. Test text/JSON results and preview/claim parity.
